root_cause: Direct Python script execution puts the run directory, rather than the repository root, at sys.path[0]; the validation helper imported house before adding the repository root.
comparison: python3 -c can import house from repository cwd; the direct script cannot before bootstrap.
single_fix: derive repository root from __file__, prepend it to sys.path before importing the candidate module
fix_scope: workflow validation helper only; production source and test scope unchanged
verification: direct independent checker and full unittest discovery pass after the one change
